dependencySomeCoreBackendFilesAreMissing: Amadosiye yibanze yinyuma yabuze cyangwa yangiritse - ibi mubisanzwe bivuze ko gukuramo byahagaritswe cyangwa ububiko bwakuweho igice gusa. Siba inyuma hanyuma wongere uyikure muri Novera igenamiterere.
dependencyInstallNcclFromTheNvidiaDevelo: Shyira NCCL uhereye kuri NVIDIA Urubuga rwabateza imbere. NCCL ikoreshwa kuri byinshi - GPU itumanaho rusange.
dependencyInstallNcclViaTheNvidiaPackage: Hifashije NCCL kuri package repository ya NVIDIA. Ku Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install libnccl2 libnccl-dev. Reba inama z'ubwoko bw'installation ya NVIDIA NCCL ku distro yawe.
dependencyInstallCudnnFromTheNvidiaDevel: Hifashije cuDNN kuri site ya NVIDIA Developer kandi wishyire DLLs hagati ya porogaramu cyangwa muri System32.
dependencyInstallCudnnViaTheNvidiaPackag: Hifashije cuDNN kuri package repository ya NVIDIA cyangwa wishyire tarball kandi wishyire libs kuri /usr/local/cuda/lib64.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanRuntimeFromLun: Shyiramo Vulkan Igihe cyagenwe kuva LunarG. Umushoferi wawe GPU} ashobora kuba yarashizemo - vugurura mbere GPU umushoferi wawe.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanLoaderOnUbuntu: Shyira Vulkan umutwaro: kuri Ubuntu / Debian: sudo apt install libvulkan1. Kuri Arch: sudo pacman -S vulkan-icd-loader. Kuri RHEL / Fedora: sudo dnf install vulkan-loader.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkitFromNvidi: Shyiramo CUDA Igitabo kuva NVIDIA. Mugihe cyo kwishyiriraho, hitamo "CUDA" ibice.
Shyiramo CUDA Igitabo kuva NVIDIA. Kuri Debian / Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-12. Kuri RHEL / Fedora: koresha NVIDIA repo.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit11FromNvi: Shyiramo CUDA Igitabo cya 11 kuva NVIDIA. Mugihe cyo kwishyiriraho, hitamo "CUDA" ibice.
Shyiramo CUDA Igitabo cya 11 kuva NVIDIA. Kuri Debian / Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-11. Kuri RHEL / Fedora: koresha NVIDIA repo.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit12FromNvi: Shyiramo CUDA Igitabo 12 kuva NVIDIA. Mugihe cyo kwishyiriraho, hitamo "CUDA" ibice.
Shyiramo CUDA Igitabo 12 kuva NVIDIA. Kuri Debian / Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-12. Kuri RHEL / Fedora: koresha NVIDIA repo.
dependencyInstallTheCudaToolkit13FromNvi: Shyiramo CUDA Igitabo 13 kuva NVIDIA. Mugihe cyo kwishyiriraho, hitamo "CUDA" ibice.
Shyiramo CUDA Igitabo cya 13 kuva NVIDIA. Kuri Debian / Ubuntu: sudo apt install cuda-toolkit-13. Kuri RHEL / Fedora: koresha NVIDIA repo.
generationCountHint: Hitamo umubare w'amashusho, inzira z'umuziki cyangwa amashusho yo kubyara (1-10). Buri kintu cyakozwe muburyo bukurikiranye. Hagarika guhagarika imirimo isigaye.
